explanation: The ballot of 27 November was brought forward by a week for a reason. The president had dissolved the Assembly on 5 November, and the party needed a candidate for prime minister before the campaign. This election chose a leader for the next two years and the name at the head of the largest opposition list on 30 January. The edge is `precondition-of` because the legislative election was already called when this one was held. The party settled who would fight it, and not whether it would happen.
